plain: A man named Dan Sheehan, on Jesse Michels's podcast, recalls a woman named Karen, one of the people studied by John Mack, a researcher of those who say they were visited by non-human beings. Sheehan says Karen would fight back against the beings by throwing things at them, even lamps. It is told to show that not everyone met these visitors calmly.
